review_comment: Added bounds check prevents buffer overflow for palette mode PCX images by validating that image width does not exceed allocated buffer capacity. The patch addresses a missing validation that could allow specially crafted PCX files to trigger memory corruption during decoding. Ensure similar validation exists for all supported image modes and that buffer allocation consistently accounts for worst-case decoding requirements.

Added bounds validation for palette mode PCX images prevents buffer overflow when image width exceeds allocated buffer capacity. The patch correctly sets an error code and returns early when the bounds check fails. Ensure downstream error handling properly prevents processing of images that trigger this overflow condition.

Test addition expands validation of buffer overrun detection in PCX image processing. The test ensures malformed pcx_overrun2.bin triggers proper error handling instead of allowing unsafe memory access. Maintain consistent error message validation across all image format tests to ensure uniform security boundary enforcement.
